description: This file defines a static class 'CatalogInstruments' that contains static fields and methods for creating and managing various performance and diagnostic metrics related to activation processes within the Orleans runtime. It includes counters and gauges for tracking activation failures, collections, shutdowns, and resource usage.

classes.name: CatalogInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing instrumentation metrics for activation processes in Orleans.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaCollection
methods.description: Increments the shutdown counter indicating shutdown via collection.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaDeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Increments the shutdown counter indicating shutdown via deactivate on idle.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaMigration
methods.description: Increments the shutdown counter indicating shutdown via migration.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaDeactivateStuckActivation
methods.description: Increments the shutdown counter indicating shutdown due to a stuck activation.

methods.name: RegisterActivationCountObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for tracking the current activation count.

methods.name: RegisterActivationWorkingSetObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for tracking the current activation working set.
